ink.$description: Ink — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas and section backgrounds — the warm off-white ground that sets the whole system apart from stark-white SaaS

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, product UI panels, testimonial tiles, integration logos — lifted off the Bone canvas to create depth

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary borders, body text dividers, nav rules — one step lighter than Ink for layered information

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Muted body text, helper labels, subtle borders — the middle gray for de-emphasized content

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary borders, caption text — the quietest gray, used where structure must recede

linen.$description: Linen — Elevated surface tint, nav background variant — sits between Bone and Paper for subtle layering

mist.$description: Mist — Shadow color base, very light dividers — the tonal anchor for the 2% opacity shadow system

signal-red.$description: Signal Red — Brand accent for highlighted feature cards, active nav indicators, and emphasis strokes — used in 5% of the interface to make the other 95% feel intentional

network-blue.$description: Network Blue — Decorative product-screenshot gradient — warm red against matte black creates urgency without aggression; blue is reserved for inside-the-product imagery, never for UI controls

inter.$description: Primary workhorse — body text at 400/16px, UI at 500/14px, and headlines at 300/48-64px. The light-weight headlines are a signature anti-convention choice: most infra brands shout with 700+, Tailscale whispers with 300, creating authority through restraint rather than volume.

mdio.$description: Branded labels and eyebrows — appears on small caps tags, nav items, and category markers with 0.043-0.050em positive tracking. The wide letter-spacing transforms tiny text into technical insignia rather than body copy. This is the system's 'voice' font.
